data.title: 陈 · 雨夜霓虹窗前的卸甲片刻
data.description: 龙门深夜飘着细密冷雨，远处高楼的青红霓虹隔着玻璃在地板上拉出朦胧倒影。陈卸去全部警备与配剑，身着炭黑青边真丝内衣靠在半掩的落地窗框边，手里握着半杯温水静静听雨，难得褪去紧绷，只留沉静清冷的亲近感。
data.location: 龙门高层公寓能望见雨幕霓虹的落地窗边
data.action: 斜倚落地窗框手持水杯望向雨夜，回眸神色柔和
data.lighting: 窗外冷冽青红城市霓虹与室内低暖落地灯勾勒身姿
data.camera: 中景略侧，玻璃雨滴与霓虹光斑化作虚焦前景
data.mood: 冷清、松弛、褪去防备后的温柔
data.promptProse: Leaning quietly against the rain-streaked floor-to-ceiling window of her Lungmen apartment, Ch'en holds a glass of warm water with her guard finally lowered. Soft teal and crimson city neon reflects across her charcoal silk satin bralette while dim indoor lamplight warms her bare shoulders.
data.animaCaption: She leans against the rain-streaked high-rise window holding a glass of water as neon bokeh glows behind her.
data.nsfwProse: The charcoal satin bralette with deep-teal ribbons and high-leg briefs catch the dim indoor lamp and cool window reflections.
